title: 第十一章 乱世三人组
slug: 重生末日最强生存系统

第(1/3)页

林夕吃痛的坐了起来，呲牙咧嘴的冲着孙悦说道：“你轻一点！”

孙悦急忙松开了手，看着林夕呲牙咧嘴的样子，又联想到林夕战斗时的冷冰冰的样子，顿时捂着嘴笑了起来。

林夕恶狠狠地冲着孙悦说道：“你再笑，信不信我揍你！”

孙悦急忙离开林夕老远的距离。

林夕看着逃的老远的孙悦无奈的摇了摇头。

就在这时，张常走了进来说道：“你醒了林夕。”林夕无奈的说道：“没醒，我还昏着呢。”

张常摸了摸头嘿嘿嘿的笑了起来。

孙悦开口说道：“接下来，你有什么打算？”

林夕躺了下来，看了看天花板说道：“我也不知道。”

其实林夕确实是不知道要去做什么，他现在完全就是依赖于系统了。“不，不能这样，如果有一天，系统突然消失了，那我岂不是就会很无助，上一世最大的炎黄根据地在Z州，我们现在距离Z州也不算太远，那就去Z州吧！”

想到这里，林夕猛地一下坐了起来，给同样在沉思的两人下了一跳，孙悦说道：“你干嘛！？”

林夕说道：“我准备去Z州。”

孙悦疑惑的说道：“为什么？”

林夕说道：“距离我们最近的部队，就在Z州，现在这种情况下，等待救援需要等待很久，既然我们有能力，为什么不把主动权掌握在自己身上。”

林夕嘴上这么说，心里却想“总不能告诉你们我知道在不久的将来第一个根据地也是最大的人类根据地就在郑州吧？”

Page (1/3)

Lin Xi sat up in pain, grinned and said to Sun Yue, "Be gentle!"

Sun Yue hurriedly let go of his hand, looked at Lin Xi's grinning look, and thought of Lin Xi's cold look when fighting, he immediately covered his mouth and laughed.

Lin Xi said fiercely to Sun Yue: "If you laugh again, believe it or not, I will beat you!"

Sun Yue hurriedly left a long distance away from Lin Xi.

Lin Xi looked at Sun Yue who was escaping far away and shook her head helplessly.

At this moment, Zhang Chang walked in and said, "You woke up Lin Xi." Lin Xi said helplessly, "I didn't wake up, I'm still unconscious."

Zhang Chang touched his head and laughed.

Sun Yue said: "What are your plans next?"

Lin Xi lay down, looked at the ceiling and said, "I don't know either."

In fact, Lin Xi really didn't know what to do. He was completely dependent on the system now."No, it can't be like this. If one day, the system suddenly disappears, then I will be very helpless. The largest Yanhuang base in the previous life was in Z state. We are not too far away from Z state now, so let's go to Z state!"

Thinking of this, Lin Xi sat up suddenly, startling the two people who were also meditating, and Sun Yue said: "What are you doing!?"

Lin Xi said: "I'm going to Z state."

Sun Yue said doubtfully: "Why?"

Lin Xi said: "The troops closest to us are in Z state. Under the current circumstances, it will take a long time to wait for rescue. Since we have the ability, why not take the initiative ourselves."

Lin Xi said this, but thought in her heart, "I can't tell you that I know that the first and largest human base in the near future will be in Zhengzhou, right?"
